result.summary: The application interface appears mostly functional, but there is a major layout issue involving clipped text for a restaurant name.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout or font size to ensure the full name of the restaurant is displayed, or allow the text to wrap to the next line.
